name: Screenshot
what_it_does: Inserts a snapshot of any open window (gallery of live thumbnails) or a Screen Clipping region; the result is a picture (Picture Format applies).
behavior: Opens Screenshot (dropdown). Contents (4 controls): Color swatches, Screenshot, Claude, Screen Clipping. [flyout of subfeature:screenshot-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Available Windows] Appears as a camera over a window frame with a dashed border.
